printed_assertion_map.Enchant creature: Actual paid casts on opposing power2 creature, noncreature rejection. Initial Aura cast has neither own-control nor power1 restriction; attachment remains after control transfer.
printed_assertion_map.Enchanted creature gets +2/+2 and has fl: Actual4/4 Bear Cub and3/3 Llanowar Elves, flying recipients but not Aura; removal clears bonuses. Shared actual flying/reach combat regression passed. Enchanted Archivist entry observer freezes power2 from the preinstalled Aura bonus.
printed_assertion_map.Hybrid spell and activation cost: Both seats, all3 UU/WU/WW equivalents with2generic; exact pool exhaustion. Insufficient colored and total payment rejected, owned hybrid selection permits independent mixed/white branches.
printed_assertion_map.From YOUR graveyard: Own graveyard source activated, hand/battlefield/opponent graveyard sources rejected. Exact source exiled or removed-and-returned graveyard incarnation cannot be rebound by old packet.
printed_assertion_map.Target creature YOU CONTROL with power1: Current signed powers -2/0/1 accepted,2 excluded; opponent creature/land/graveyard creature excluded; own hexproof and actual1/1 token allowed. Power growth, control transfer, protection and departure/reentry in response make the original target illegal; source stays exact graveyard card, mana stays spent.
printed_assertion_map.Return attached: Actual entry remains attached even when its bonus makes power3. Actual one-per-turn enchantment-entry draw observer captures source power2 and draws one, with no additional Aura-entry decision. Aura recipient bounce causes actual Aura SBA and, with active Rest in Peace, actual exile replacement; otherwise card is activated from resulting graveyard and returns attached.
printed_assertion_map.Activate only as a sorcery: Combat, occupied stack and another player active turn rejected; main-phase own priority succeeds.
printed_assertion_map.Privacy / transaction / owned roots: Illegal action snapshots/revisions remain equal. Opponent hand fixture remains private while graveyard source public to both. Representative raw/index/restore root during hybrid activation selection, parent drop, independently resolved children, mixed-vs-white remaining mana outcomes.
